name: 金庸群侠传（2008 标准版）
english_name: Legend of Jin Yong's Heroes (2008 Standard Edition)
english_description: This archive corresponds to the base "2008" (Standard) content release, sharing an identical server engine core with this project's "2008 Enhanced" edition (the master, login, and security modules match byte for byte), with only somewhat fewer quests and lighter scene descriptions than the Enhanced edition.
